body:
### Verification of 3.3.2rc1 / Task SDK 1.3.2rc1

I ran the PMC mechanical checks from `dev/README_RELEASE_AIRFLOW.md` against the staged artefacts (svn r87505). Result: **pass, with two non-blocking warnings that are both pre-existing in the released 3.3.1**.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Artefact inventory | PASS — 15 Airflow files + 6 Task SDK, nothing missing or unexpected |
| GPG signatures | PASS — 7/7 good, signing key present in the project KEYS file |
| Checksums | PASS — 7/7 sha512, no deprecated md5 |
| Licence headers (Apache RAT 0.18) | PASS — 9591 files, 0 unapproved, 0 unknown |
| NOTICE / LICENSE | PASS — NOTICE unchanged vs 3.3.1; LICENSE +20 lines, intentional (#73067) |
| Version consistency | PASS — `3.3.2` / `1.3.2` throughout |
| **Reproducible build** | **PASS — all 7 artefacts bit-for-bit identical** |

Reproducibility was checked from a clean `git clone --branch 3.3.2rc1` using the default Docker build path. All seven artefacts compare byte-identical to the staged ones.

The LICENSE addition is correct and complete: the OFL-1.1 section added by #73067 covers JetBrains Mono and Plus Jakarta Sans, both `LICENSE-*.txt` files ship in the source release, and both `.woff2` files they cover are present. (`codicon.ttf` in the core wheel is a Monaco Editor asset, already covered by the existing MIT entry — not a gap.)

#### Two warnings — neither blocks the vote

**1. Five dangling symlinks in the source release.** `.claude/skills/{aip-user-stories,airflow-translations,magpie-setup,prepare-providers-documentation,upgrade-fab-provider}` all point at `../../.agents/skills/...`. `.gitattributes` has `.agents export-ignore` but no `.claude export-ignore`, so the relay symlinks ship while their targets are stripped. Present since #67929 and identical in the released 3.3.1. One-line fix for a follow-up PR on main, not for this RC.

**2. `java-sdk/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` (43 KB) in the source release.** RAT classifies it as an archive and does not complain. Identical at the `3.3.1` tag. Worth a policy decision eventually — ASF prefers source releases free of compiled binaries — but not grounds to -1 here.

#### The 23 items assigned to me

All 23 are in the `3.3.2rc1` tag, and all 23 are new in 3.3.2.

Nine of them — #70597, #71428, #71434, #71451, #71512, #71640, #71785, #71828, #71838 — do **not** appear under the merge-commit SHA the API reports, because `v3-3-test` was rebased/force-pushed after they merged. I re-confirmed each by matching the PR reference in the tag history and comparing `git patch-id --stable` between the original and rewritten commits: all nine carry byte-identical patches. The other fourteen (#72660, #72712, #72723, #72728, #72806, #72874, #72933, #73041, #73042, #73043, #73046, #73051, #73067, #73068) are direct ancestors of the tag.

Worth noting that #73068 (RAT excludes, move to Apache RAT 0.18) is itself in this RC, and the RAT run above used the 0.18 image it pins — so that fix is verified against the artefact it was meant to fix.

These checks are mechanical and say nothing about runtime behaviour; an install-and-exercise pass is still needed for a binding vote.

issue.title: Marking a Dag run success/failed returns 409 Conflict on first attempt (3.3.1 regression)

labels.name: kind:bug
labels.description: This is a clearly a bug

repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
### Under which category would you file this issue?

Airflow Core

### Apache Airflow version

3.3.1

### What happened and how to reproduce it?

Marking a Dag run as success or failed from the UI returns `409 Conflict`
("Update Dag Run Request Failed"), but the change is applied anyway - the run
and its task instances are updated, and the UI shows an error for an operation
that actually succeeded.

It only happens the **first** time a given run is marked. Marking the same run
again succeeds with no error.

The api-server log shows:

`Error with id ..., statement: INSERT INTO dag_run_note
(user_id, dag_run_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (...)`

i.e. a duplicate-key violation on `dag_run_note`, surfaced as 409 by
`_UniqueConstraintErrorHandler`. It happens even with the Note field left empty.

Works correctly in 3.3.0.

To reproduce:

1. Fresh 3.3.1 install, Postgres, any Dag.
2. Trigger a run and leave it un-started.
3. Mark the run as success (or failed) from the UI, leaving the Note box empty.
4. The red "Conflict" toast appears; the run is nevertheless marked and its
   task instances updated.
5. Mark the same run again - this time it succeeds silently.


### What you think should happen instead?

The request should return 200 and no duplicate insert should be attempted.

---
The cause is in `_set_dag_run_terminal_state`
(`airflow-core/src/airflow/api/common/mark_tasks.py`):

```python
for ti in pending_normal_tis:
    ti.set_state(TaskInstanceState.SKIPPED)
```

`TaskInstance.set_state` is decorated with `@provide_session` and no session is
passed here, so it opens its own session, calls `session.merge(self)` and
commits it. `TaskInstance.dag_run` is `lazy="joined"`, so that merge cascades
TI → DagRun → `dag_run_note` and carries the still-unflushed `DagRunNote` into
the second session, which commits it. The request's session then commits its
own copy of the same row, and the second insert violates `dag_run_note_pkey`.

This surfaces in 3.3.1 because `patch_dag_run` now applies the note before the
state, so a note is attached to the DagRun at the moment that merge happens. In
3.3.0 the state ran first and there was nothing to cascade.

The fix is to pass the session through:

```python
for ti in pending_normal_tis:
    ti.set_state(TaskInstanceState.SKIPPED, session=session)
```

That keeps the note-before-state ordering intact and produces a single insert.
Verified locally on 3.3.1: the 409 is gone, and the run and its task instances
update as expected.

### Operating System

macOS

### Deployment

Other

### Apache Airflow Provider(s)

_No response_

### Versions of Apache Airflow Providers

_No response_

### Official Helm Chart version

Not Applicable

_No response_

# Apache Airflow 開源貢獻紀錄 by Eason09053360（2026-02 ～ 2026-10-16）

## 總覽：2026 年 2 月 – 10 月（截至 10/16）

- PR: apache/airflow merged 56 個（[清單](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3AEason09053360+is%3Amerged)）+ 4 個 open
  - 其中 22 個被 backport 到 release 分支（`v3-3-test` 14、`airflow-ctl/v0-1-test` 6、`chart/v1-2x-test` 2）

| Helm chart | 2 |
| UI（E2E 測試） | 1 |

主攻是 **Airflow 3 遷移後留下的 CLI / airflowctl / API 正確性問題**，大多是「靜默出錯」型的 bug：exit 0 但結果是錯的、資料被默默改掉、操作其實成功但 CLI 噴 traceback等等。

---

## October 2026（截至 10/16）

**Summary**

- PR: 3 merged + 2 open
- Code Review: 10
- Issue Triage: 1

### PR（merged）

#### Task SDK

- [Fix dateless dag.test and tasks test destroying unrelated Dag runs (#73813)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73813)：`Bug 修正`
  - `dag.test()` / `airflow tasks test` 不帶日期時，會刪掉使用者從 UI 觸發的 Dag run
  - Airflow 3 的手動 / asset 觸發 run 沒有 logical date（`NULL`），但 `get_or_create_dagrun` 用 `==` 查詢，SQLAlchemy 會產生 `IS NULL`，於是刪掉任意一個 dateless run，連帶 cascade 刪掉 task instances
  - `DAG.test()` 的 `clear_dags` 拿 `None` 當上下界，兩個條件都被丟掉，變成清掉這個 Dag **所有** run 的 TI

#### airflow CLI

- [Fix CLI --bundle-name finding no Dags in Git bundles (#73377)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73377)：`Bug 修正`
  - 4 個 CLI 呼叫點沒有先 `bundle.initialize()`（Git bundle 靠它 clone repo），`dags list --local --bundle-name X` 回傳空清單卻 exit 0、`list-import-errors` 回報「沒有錯誤」
  - `tasks test` / `dags test` / `tasks clear` 則退回掃描所有 bundle，可能拿到**另一個 bundle 裡同名的 Dag**
  - [#53699](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/53699) 只修了當時被回報的那一處，這次把其餘呼叫點一起補齊

#### airflowctl

- [Fix airflowctl pools export/import dropping pool team ownership (#73132)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73132)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - `airflowctl pools export` → `import --action-on-existing-key overwrite` 會清掉 pool 的 team 歸屬，而且回報成功
  - multi-team 部署用 `team_name` 決定誰能用這個 pool；export 沒寫出這個欄位，bulk 請求又把缺少的欄位序列化成 `"team_name": null` 覆寫回去
  - 舊的 `airflow pools export / import` 本來就有處理，只有照著 deprecation 提示遷移到 airflowctl 的使用者會中招

### PR（open）

#### API server

- [Stop the JWT revocation check stalling the API server event loop (#74364)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74364)：`Bug 修正`
  - JWT revocation 檢查在 event loop 上做同步 DB 查詢，UI polling、worker heartbeat、airflowctl 全部排在後面，connection pool 滿了就逐一 timeout

#### Dag processing

- [Fix sync-perm applying permissions from every stored Dag version (#74360)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74360)：`Bug 修正`
  - `airflow sync-perm --include-dags` 對每個 Dag 依每個版本各 sync 一次且無排序，已撤銷的 role 權限可能被舊版本重新授予

### Code Review

- [Add --asset-ids filtering to db clean (#74498)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74498)
  - `db clean --asset-ids` 會連同 `asset_dag_run_queue` 刪掉還在排隊的舊 asset event，排程在 `a & b` 上的 Dag 等到 `b` 來了也不會跑
  - 指出 [#74495](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74495) 對同樣情境預設是拒絕（409），建議比照處理
- [Snowflake oauth2 password (fork repository fix) (#74804)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74804)
  - `grant_type` 只在 extra 有 `grant_type` 或 `refresh_token` 時才設定，兩者都沒有的既有 OAuth 連線會從原本的明確錯誤訊息變成 `KeyError: 'grant_type'`
  - `get_oauth_token(grant_type="client_credentials")` 也會一起壞
- [Chart: Bump PgBouncer to 1.25.2 and exporter to 0.21.0 to fix CVEs (#74647)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74647)
  - 指出 PgBouncer 1.25.2 仍有 1.26.x 才修掉的未認證 CVE，請作者在 PR 描述註明
- [Fix Cloud Composer system test external task sensors (#74786)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74786)
  - 本地驗證後 approve
  - 另外指出範例裡的 `datetime.now()` 是本地時間卻帶 `Z` 後綴送給 API，在 UTC-7 的 worker 上時間窗會早 7 小時、抓不到剛觸發的 run，而這段是會被使用者照抄的文件範例
- [Recover the revoked-token check from a stale DB connection (fixes idle-timeout 500) (#71444)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/71444)
  - 指出 FAB 3.7.0（[#68100](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/68100)）之後 `deserialize_user` 已會關閉 session，請作者確認 issue 在新版是否仍能重現
- Approve：[#74778](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74778)（本地驗證）, [#74645](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74645), [#74816](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74816), [#74243](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74243)
- 其他：[#74015](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74015)

### Issue Triage

- [AIP-44 Migrate DagModel.deactivate_deleted_dags to Internal API (#29533)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/29533)
  - 2023 年的 issue 一直沒關：查出實際已由 [#29534](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/29534) 完成（2.6.0 釋出），GitHub 只自動關了 `closes` 寫到的 #29532
  - AIP-44 Internal API 也已在 3.0.0 整個移除（[#44502](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44502)、[#44549](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44549)），建議關閉

---

## September 2026

**Summary**

- PR: 29 merged + 2 open
- Code Review: 14
- Issue Triage / RC Testing: 3

### PR（merged）

#### airflow CLI

- [Prevent Dag CLI subcommands from being silently dropped (#72340)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72340)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - `DAG.cli()`（`python my_dag.py ...`）用過期的 command name 挑 subcommand，讓 `dags backfill`、`tasks run` 靜默消失
  - `args` 用 generator 只能走一次，parser 重建後 `dags pause` 參數從 6 個掉到 2 個
- [Fix DAG.cli() crashing on dags pause and unpause (#72109)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72109)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - `python my_dag.py dags pause / unpause` 直接 `TypeError`
- [Fix DAG.cli() crashing on dags test --show-dagrun (#72810)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72810)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Stop airflow standalone leaking components when one fails to start (#72464)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72464)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`

- [Fix airflow standalone announcing readiness before the API server is up (#73025)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73025)：`Bug 修正`
  - 「Airflow is ready」在 API server 還沒 bind port 前就印出
  - 追到是 [#46942](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/46942) 刪 webserver 時把 port 檢查一起弄丟

- [Fix airflow info --file-io uploading an empty report (#72707)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72707)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Allow airflow jobs check --allow-multiple with --limit 0 (#72677)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72677)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Reject non-numeric --limit values in airflow dags list-jobs (#72891)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72891)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Fix airflow dags list --columns help showing wrong default columns (#72607)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72607)：`Bug 修正`
- [Remove ignored --output flag from airflow pools set and delete (#72833)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72833)：`Bug 修正`
- [Fix airflow teams list --output json printing prose when no teams exist (#72945)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72945)：`Bug 修正`
- [Mask the SQLite database path in airflow info --anonymize (#73179)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73179)：`Bug 修正`
